thread:
Marie (AE): Hey team — HavenBank SIG hit Q3.5 and Q7.2 about data provenance for embeddings. They want (1) an architecture diagram showing data flow from ingestion -> embeddings -> storage and (2) a short statement on KMS/HSM key custody. Can we assemble evidence today?
Alex (SE): I can pull the arch diagram and the flow svg. Will need Sam to confirm wording on KMS.
Sam (Security): I can draft the answer for KMS/HSM. Quick Q: do they need AES-GCM key wrapping details or just that keys are customer-managed via KMS?
Marie (AE): Customer preferred customer-managed keys, but they'll accept Redwood-managed if we include rotation schedule. Prefer CMKs if we can show it.
Alex (SE): Uploading diagram to S3 now — s3://redwood-evidence/havenbank/arch-2024-06-15.svg 
deploy-bot: file uploaded: arch-2024-06-15.svg (s3://redwood-evidence/havenbank/) :paperclip: 
Kim (Solutions Eng): For provenance we should also include the pipeline YAML snippet that shows where we persist embeddings and the TTL. I have a sanitized snippet.
Alex (SE): Pasting sanitized snippet:
```
pipeline:
  - name: ingest
  - name: embed
    store: embeddings-store (s3, encrypted)
    retention_days: 365
```
Sam (Security): Draft answer for Q3.5 (data provenance): 
"Redwood maintains an auditable data flow diagram and pipeline manifests that show ingestion, transformation (embedding generation), and storage locations. Embeddings are stored in customer-dedicated buckets encrypted with KMS-managed keys. Access to the keys follows RBAC and is logged in audit events."
Sam (Security): For KMS/HSM statement (Q7.2) draft: 
"Redwood supports customer-managed keys via cloud KMS (e.g., AWS KMS BYOK). Keys can be HSM-backed. When customers opt for Redwood-managed keys, we rotate keys every 90 days and publish rotation events to audit logs. Full key access events are retained for 1 year."
Marie (AE): Nice. Can someone attach the rotation schedule PDF and the KMS compliance checklist? Customer will want doc-level evidence.
Alex (SE): Uploaded: rotation-schedule.pdf and kms-checklist.pdf to the same s3 path. deploy-bot: files uploaded: rotation-schedule.pdf, kms-checklist.pdf :white_check_mark: 
Kim (Solutions Eng): Also adding a short evidence snippet for deletion policy: "Embeddings deletion requests trigger a pipeline job that zeroes objects and retires keys; we record the job id and timestamp in audit.log." Put that in the answers doc.
Marie (AE): Ok let's assemble a single answer bundle. Alex — can you create a one-page "answers.docx" that contains the two drafted paragraphs + links to diagrams and PDFs?
Alex (SE): On it. Will drop link here when done.
Alex (SE): answers.docx uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/havenbank/answers-docx-1726341399.docx 
Sam (Security): Quick review: suggested minor wording change to second para — replace "rotate keys every 90 days" with "rotate per customer policy; default rotation interval is 90 days" — less absolute.
Marie (AE): Good call. Alex can you update and re-upload?
Alex (SE): Updated and re-uploaded. New file: s3://redwood-evidence/havenbank/answers-docx-1726341399-v2.docx 
Marie (AE): Thanks all. I'll send to the customer with the S3 links and short note. If they push for HSM attestation, Sam can follow up with the compliance pack. :thumbsup:
Sam (Security): Will prep the compliance pack if requested.
Kim (Solutions Eng): Add note for support to watch for delete/retention escalation.
Marie (AE): Closing this thread, will post any customer replies here. :pray:
